arrows.S1: Bipolarity gives an opposite-polarity parent clause; linearity ensures it shares with the source clause only x, so the resolvent cannot contain a complementary literal pair. Thus G3.
arrows.S2: The 15 clauses incident to x have pairwise disjoint external variable pairs by linearity. Every positive-negative pair yields a non-tautological 4-literal resolvent, and different parent pairs yield different external-variable unions. Hence exactly p_x q_x=56 distinct non-tautological resolvents.
arrows.S3: 56 > 7+8 = 15, so the first frozen BVE acceptance conjunct fails for every x; therefore G4.
arrows.S4: A complete 3-variable affine bundle requires four clauses on the same variable triple; linearity forbids two distinct clauses from sharing all three variables, so R34 cannot recognize.
arrows.S5: For an R35B candidate on source clause C={l,a,b}, assumptions falsify a and b, making C unit on l. UP may assign l's variable. Any other clause intersects C in at most one variable by linearity, so after all three source variables are assigned it still has at least two unassigned variables; no further unit or conflict can arise. Thus G5.
arrows.S6: 15-regularity gives 3m=15n, so m=5n. Since each variable has at least 7 positive occurrences, total positive occurrences is at least 7n. A Horn CNF has at most one positive literal per clause, hence at most m=5n positive occurrences. Contradiction; therefore NOT_HORN.

linear_15_regular_7_8_signed_3cnf_suffic.conclusion: By the proved main lemma, every formula satisfying the subclass assumptions is an unchanged one-cycle STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT of the exact frozen USF reducer.

proof: Nonempty F excludes EMPTY_CNF.
Every clause has exactly three literals, so no empty clause and no unit clause.
Three distinct variable identities per clause forbid simultaneous x and -x, hence no tautological clause.

Any subset relation between two distinct 3-literal clauses would, by equal cardinality, force equal literal sets; canonical_formula removes exact duplicate clauses, so no proper subsumption remains between distinct canonical clauses.
Every clause has size 3, so is_2cnf(F) is false.
L0.statement: Exact simple nonempty 3-CNF plus canonical duplicate elimination excludes the early syntactic cases.

proof: Take any used variable x and any occurrence literal l in some clause C.
G3 requires a clause D containing -l with a non-tautological resolvent.
Therefore the opposite polarity of x occurs.
If no D contained -l, frozen first_blocked_clause would leave ok=True and l would block C, so the vacuous BCE case is covered.
L1.statement: G3 implies bipolar occurrence for every used variable.

proof: Frozen first_blocked_clause marks (C,l) blocked exactly when every clause containing -l yields a tautological resolvent; this universal condition is vacuously true when there is no opposite clause.
Therefore first_blocked_clause(F)=None exactly when every (C,l) has an opposite-polarity D with a non-tautological resolvent, which is G3.
L2.statement: G3 iff first_blocked_clause(F)=None on the stated domain.

proof: For each x, frozen bve_candidate computes distinct non-tautological R_x, removes P_x union N_x, forms canonical T_x(F), and fires iff both |R_x| <= |P_x|+|N_x| and measure(T_x(F)) < measure(F).
G4_EXACT is the pointwise negation of that exact conjunction for every x.
The stronger resolvent-surplus condition G4S is not substituted.
L3.statement: G4_EXACT_NO_BVE_CANDIDATE excludes every frozen BVE candidate.

proof: L0 excludes tautology, unit, subsumption and 2CNF; L1 excludes pure literal; L2 excludes BCE; L3 excludes BVE.
Thus R33 history is empty and active remains F.
NOT_HORN excludes the Horn terminal.
The exact frozen else-terminal is STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE.
L4.statement: R33 leaves F unchanged and returns STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE.

proof: Frozen R34 groups clauses by variable set and recognizes only when every group is a complete parity halfcube with exactly 2^(k-1) clauses and one falsifying parity class.
Within exact simple 3-CNF k=3 for every group, so recognition means the whole formula is a conjunction of complete four-clause parity bundles.
G_AFF is precisely the complement of that condition on this domain.
first_rup_strengthening exhaustively checks every clause and every removed literal, using assumptions that negate the remaining strengthened clause.
G5 states every one of those UP calls is non-conflicting, so proposal=None.

run_candidate first performs UP(F, empty assumptions). With exact 3-CNF and empty assignment every clause has three unassigned literals; therefore no clause is empty or unit, no assignment is added, and the scan terminates with conflict=False.
The same argument applies to the explicit final unassumed UP check after proposal=None because F has not changed.
Hence status=STALLED_RUP_CORE, successful_strengthenings=0 and final_formula=F.
L6.statement: G5 forces R35B zero strengthenings and the final unassumed UP check cannot conflict.

proof: L4 gives R33 terminal STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE and unchanged F.
L5 gives R34 recognized=False.
L6 gives R35B zero history and after_rup=after_r33=F.
The controller compares canonical DIMACS hashes and on equality sets terminal=STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT, appends the cycle and breaks before restart.
Therefore total transformations=0, residual F is literally unchanged, cycle_count=1 and restart_count=0.
L7.statement: The USF generic frozen controller terminates after one cycle at STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT with no restart.
